consistency.method: CLIP-ViT-H and DINOv3 cosine over 28 hand-boxed face crops, with a purpose-built between-person floor (6 siblings).
consistency.verdict: THE EMBEDDING METRIC FAILED ITS OWN CONTROL AND IS NOT REPORTED AS EVIDENCE. SIB6 - a different woman wearing the same glasses, hair, skin tone and jacket - scored 0.865 on CLIP-ViT-H (above 8 of the 16 genuine frames) and 0.967 on DINOv3, the highest score in the whole matrix. Both encoders rank a stranger above the real thing, so they are measuring photographic similarity, not identity. The consistency claim rests on the MARKS instead, which are countable.
